Beyond the Manual Log
Analog Chaos
Paper logs and manual key tags lead to delays, lost keys, and guest frustration during peak hours.
Visual Pollution
Ugly parking markings on premium hotel surroundings like chalk numbers, paint, or cones diminish luxury appeal.
Liability Blindspots
Without immediate photo evidence of existing damage, your hotel remains exposed to costly false claims.
Respect the Surroundings
"We value your parking surroundings and want to avoid ugly markings. Instead of chalk numbers, painted spots, or temporary floor labels, we built a smarter way  using data you already capture at check-in. One photo, one digital record, and your team always knows where the car is. Clean aesthetics outside. Complete clarity inside."
